fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (MU -5.78%) surpassed $1 trillion market cap in early this year but has since declined to approximately $94 billion, with 30-day average trading volume significantly lower than the June peak.
fields.summary_ko.1: MU has risen over 1,000% in five years, but faces high risk of sharp decline if memory supply increases; the P/E of 11x is attributable only to recent exceptional earnings, which appears unsustainable.
